description: For the business's own assistant answering a customer: when the customer asks about something on the business's website (a product, a price, a promotion) and what you have from it was read more than a day ago, read it again now. Returns each website's latest text and when it was read. At most every ten minutes per business; otherwise it returns what was read last.
name: refresh_business_website
title: Read a business's website again
